ledger.x: 1949: the Hungarian People's Republic is proclaimed.
1956: the Red Army moves on Budapest.
1989: the People's Republic ends on 23 October, the 33rd anniversary of the revolution.

wars.name: Hungarian Revolution of 1956
wars.outcome: Soviet victory (infobox, 23 October - 11 November 1956): the Red Army occupied Budapest on 24 October, withdrew, and returned on 4 November; Kádár replaced Nagy.
